headline: Muku jumps from 1,226th to 65th on ARC-3

sections.text: Muku gained 6.47 to 34.89, moving from 1226th to 65th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board in the past day.
The entry is listed under its own name. Standings remain provisional, and medals are decided on the private board.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
